## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change; a bigger change was agreed in an issue first.
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix starts with a failing test). No test was weakened.
- [ ] Ran the checks for the parts I touched (see CONTRIBUTING.md): `go vet`, `staticcheck`, `go test -race ./...`, UI/extension tests.
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased` (if users will notice the change).
- [ ] `docs/SPEC.md`, an ADR in `docs/decisions/`, or `docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md` updated if needed.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason for it is written below.
- [ ] No telemetry, tracking or new network calls; no secrets or full URLs with tokens in logs.
- [ ] If I used AI tools, I read and understand every line.
